phrases.english: Hooray! We’re flying! Dad, we’re flying!
to fly a plane (as the pilot)

phrases.latin: Nōnne poterō volāre rēctā in Austriam?
phrases.english: Can I fly directly to Austria?

phrases.latin: Tibi volandum erit aut per Parīsiōs aut Francofordiam.
phrases.english: You will have to fly by way of Paris or Frankfurt.
